notes.title: A letter to players on the first anniversary
notes.notes:
Greeting Settlers,

Time flies. Since the release of "Pathless Woods" on Steam on April 3, 2024, it has been one year in the blink of an eye. This year, we released more than 20 updates, some big and some small. Unfortunately, the game has not yet reached the ideal state we and everyone expected.

We hope that "Pathless Woods" will become a unique survival and construction game, a world of free exploration and creation. Therefore, we tried many unique designs and in-depth content. During the process, we inevitably take detours and encounter setbacks. Although we try our best, we fail to do our best. But we feel that this is precisely the meaning of indie games.

Since its launch, players' feedback has been enthusiastic and valuable, and we have collected many opinions and suggestions. Special thanks to those players who participated in a large number of tests - your support is the driving force behind our persistence. We deeply apologize for seeing bugs bothering settlers; seeing you find joy in the game and a strong sense of achievement makes us exclaim that everything is worth it. We are sincerely grateful to have you accompany us all the way.

We are aware that online bugs, performance optimization, and novice guidance are still the three major shortcomings of the gaming experience. These issues affect immersion and make it difficult for new players to get started quickly. We have developed a detailed solution and will move forward with full force when the time is ripe.

The story of "Pathless Woods" began in 2017, starting with the dreams of one or two people. The team expanded to more than ten people at its peak, and now it has returned to two people. From youth to middle age, we have almost devoted our entire youth. Despite the rough road, we have never given up.

Perhaps some settlers have noticed that the last update was three or four months ago. The reason is simple: by the end of last year, the studio ran out of funds, the team had to disband, and borrowed some foreign debt to pay the final salaries and severance pay of the studio partners. In order to make a living, we took on some outsourcing projects, and the income was only enough to maintain basic living and repay.At the same time, A and I have completed a major event in our lives - getting married and starting a family, and are about to welcome a baby. This makes us feel gratified and we hope it can bring good luck to the game.

We hope that no matter how difficult it is, we can do our best to solve the above three major problems and gradually move "Pathless Woods" towards the official version. Currently, we are raising funds through outsourcing and platform transplantation, and we do not rule out employment for a period of time. We will try our best to resume updates within this year. As for the official version, it may take two to three years or even longer. We also hope to bring more revenue and support to the game by transplanting to other platforms.

Independent games are always a risky path. We carry our dreams and move forward. In the wave of domestic single-player games, even if we cannot become a surging wave, at least we have been stirred up.

Finally, thank you to every settler who supports "Pathless Woods". Your understanding and companionship are our indispensable motivation. Let's look forward to future updates and official versions together!

Wishing everyone happiness and the ability to play more and more good games.



AniYa Games Studio
2025.4.3

Dear players, since the game was released two months ago, we have received a lot of feedback. We apologize for not providing you with a good experience due to bugs, performance, operation, difficulty, and other issues.
In these two months, although the sales have been very poor, we are still putting in the last bit of resources and time to optimize updates.
In addition to fixing bugs and optimizing performance, we have compiled a relatively large adjustment update based on everyone's feedback, as follows:
Important!! Archive compatibility issue: Due to our remake of the cooking and physique system, the old archive will convert data and the physique will be adjusted to the initial value upon entry.
If you cannot accept it, you can continue running the previous version of the game and choose to do so at startup.
Sorry for any inconvenience caused to you!
1、 The difficulty selection function, in order to meet the needs of different types of players, we have set three levels of difficulty: casual, normal, and difficult. We hope it will be helpful for your gaming experience.
2、 Remake the nutritional system, food buff, and cooking system! Reduce the cost of understanding ingredients and highlight their effectiveness.
3、 Basic interaction optimization, reducing the switching of basic operation buttons, and avoiding E, Misoperation of F key.
4、 Add character information UI and process chain UI, and integrate them with "make", "build", and "help" UI into a large UI.
V Remake NPC upgrade system and add NPC upgrade cultivation line.
6、 Remove the wooden card teleportation function and switch to the Earth Monument teleportation, which can be teleported between the Earth Temple and can be teleported back to the Earth Monument at any location.
7、 Map UI Tag Filter

*8、 Server (simplified version)
Currently, a simplified version of the server has been released, which can be used to improve the issue of low host frame rates when multiple people are online
Usage:
1. Open the server directory and run: Game installation directory/Server/PathlessWoodsServer.exe
2. Create a game after running the server
3. After running the game itself, connect to the server by joining the game
4. At present, the server version has relatively rudimentary functions, which are only suitable for local operation and not suitable for being placed on cloud servers. We will continue to improve the functions in the future.

This is what our small team is currently trying to do to the best of our ability. If there is anything else that makes you very uncomfortable, you can contact us again. We are very sorry, and we will continue to update you continuously in the future.

notes.title: Development Progress & Updates: Issue #4!
notes.notes:
Hey Settlers,

We hope you're doing well! As we gear up for Steam Next Fest, we’re excited to share with you the next issue of our Development Progress & Update series. In this update, we’ll be sharing two new things: a new water flow system and implementation of random weather events within the game. 

[h2]New Water Flow System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/e6ffafd00420a6e08cc673fd04a320a332eb1ebe.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/951c28615a79bbea78609f0789c1c0cccace5de7.gif[/img]
First off, we’ve added a new water flow system! With this new feature, you can now dig new water channels to direct water from nearby sources to your land. Whether you’re looking to beautify your home, enhance your environment or improve irrigation for your crops, it’s all made more efficient with realistic water physics. Implementing this feature across different terrains and water sources was a complex task, but it was a rewarding challenge for us!

[h2]Random Weather Events[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/a489f72a0eecc10f0d2b9524f23ad13db32462d1.gif[/img]
Expect an even more exciting and unpredictable gameplay experience with the introduction of random weather events! Just like how one day it might rain and the next could be sunny, we wanted to bring a slice of real-world weather into the game. notes.title: Your Ultimate Survival Guide!
notes.notes:
Greetings Settlers!

In this post, we would like to introduce you to an important part of ensuring survival in Pathless Woods - your character’s survival metrics! Each of them are important in their own way in addressing the needs of your character, and in order to truly thrive in these mysterious lands, understanding how to balance them is crucial. Get ready to strategize, innovate, and decipher the secrets of survival in Pathless Woods!

[h2]Hunger
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/31cb4fe7610ae0745b314b27c5859de3034f5e60.gif[/img]

Life in Pathless Woods starts with ensuring you're well-fed and keeping your hunger at bay. While wandering the lands, wild mushrooms or cultivated crops will be your go-to for a quick bite. For those who relish the thrill of hunting, animals can also provide a generous supply of meat. But whether it’s foraged fungi or fresh meat, here’s a tip for you - grilling them will boost their filling power! So, don't hesitate to spark up a bonfire and savor a roasted delight. 

[h2]Hydration
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/428f8911361ebb70b6c4132ca78225dccd3fbb6d.gif[/img]

Hydration isn’t just about quenching your thirst! Lakes and ponds offer a refreshing gulp, as such, positioning your home near these natural reservoirs would be a great idea. And when you are out exploring, it's wise to have filled water bottles on hand. If you are wondering how to get it, here’s a fun fact: Take down a Jaer cultist, and they might just drop one for you. The best part is they are reusable, ready to be replenished at the next water source on your adventures! 

[h2]Temperature
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/c537fe9cc0e96a2791e772af8f38e149890b9049.gif[/img]

Pathless Woods offers varied biomes as you explore more of its mystical land, from scorching fields to freezing mountains. Crafting appropriate clothing for your climate is essential should you find yourself struggling to keep your Temperature in check.

Sometimes, even clothes won't be enough to stop the elements, and that’s when your building skills and creativity can shine! Build shelters to take refuge from the weather, whether it's the blazing sun or a chilling snowstorm.

[h2]Spirit
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/6d96197f1722e76c2473bfa603a464f0276f3eec.png[/img]

A well-rested settler is alert and ready for challenges! Without enough Spirit, you'll suffer a Dispirited debuff, decreasing your HP, and Stamina recovery speed, and reducing your other stats by a massive 20%! 

Setting up a cozy spot for the night, and getting some sleep is necessary to replenish your Spirit. Settle down by a warm bonfire, or if you have the materials, craft a firelick linen bed roll. It is warmer than a normal bedroll but be careful where you place it—especially if you’re near open flames. You don’t want to accidentally turn yourself into a chunk of charcoal!

[h2]Physique
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/d05f8fc85fa207ffba4da54b526f99c72f799788.gif[/img]

In Pathless Woods, food isn't just fuel—it improves your Physique! Boosting your Physique stat not only ups your basic stats like Attack and Max HP but also lets you handle heftier furniture, equip stronger armor, and wield better weapons and tools to protect yourself. Plus, a higher Physique means more room in your belly, letting you go longer without grub. For a real advantage, diversify your meals and grill up those ingredients; it's about quality, not just quantity!

Navigating the intricacies of Pathless Woods demands more than just instinct—it requires a mastery of the vital survival metrics. From optimizing your diet for Physique to ensuring you're adequately hydrated and well-rested, each metric plays a pivotal role in your journey. Equip yourself with this knowledge, and you're not just surviving—you're thriving!

We're thrilled to unveil more about how to survive in Pathless Woods, and look forward to seeing how you would adapt to the mysterious lands. Thank you so much for your continued support, and we can’t wait for you to embark on this adventure with us!

notes.title: Pathless Woods - Development Progress & Updates: Issue #1!
notes.notes:
Hey Settlers, welcome back to Pathless Woods! 

In this post, we would like to share some of our development progress in terms of optimizing the in-game models and improving the tutorial playthrough system!

[h2]Improved Graphics Optimization[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/1ec5016e1b4c7d454b872e34c25f54aa8e133dac.gif[/img]
[i]Old game model[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/2d1af0b5167d12d5c5055cccf8474fd6ebba1d45.gif[/img]
[i]New optimized high-resolution model[/i]

As you may know, Pathless Woods is a sandbox game with a vast open world with detailed game models & objects. This would require significant computing power to render them in the game world. During the closed beta testing phase, we've also received feedback from some players about lag and decreased frame rates. As a result, we have been optimizing the game to ensure players have the best possible experience. We've thoroughly modified all game models to reduce their graphical processing demands.

Here is one example of the optimization that we've made! Now, objects that are farther away from the player are shown in lower resolution until the player approaches, at which point the models switch to a more detailed, high-resolution version. This way, there wouldn't be too much processing power required for distant objects, and we believe this will make the gameplay experience much smoother.

[h2]Improved Tutorials[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/c7de2769dffbcef89a731f04888fc264ff031fd0.gif[/img]
[i]Snippets of our new tutorial island![/i]

Next, we've also been working on improving the tutorial systems in the game. Based on feedback from the closed beta testing, the current tutorial island in Pathless Woods is quite complex and has a steep learning curve due to the large amount of tutorial content and branching paths. As such, we have streamlined the tutorials to help players quickly grasp the basic mechanics so that they can dive straight into the world of Pathless Woods! As for the more complex tutorial content, we've decided to move it into the main game, which will allow for an overall smoother gameplay experience! 

[h2]Additional Furniture and Building Content[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/d3ef6e2972724dd4d222bb7fb5378b04bfea7855.gif[/img]

Lastly, we're working on adding a ton of traditional Chinese-style elements to the game such as decorations, furniture and building content. We want to make sure that the game feels authentic and immersive. With a wider range of building options, players can fully express their creativity and design structures that truly embody the culture and architecture of ancient China. In addition, we would love to know what type of decorations you'd like to see in the game as well, so feel free to share your suggestions with us in the comments below!

We hope you enjoyed this look into the development progress of Pathless Woods! We're constantly working to improve the game and make it the best it can be, and are committed to regularly updating and sharing our development progress with you. We're always open to feedback and suggestions, so please don't hesitate to reach out to us!

notes.title: Pathless Woods Dev Update: Optimizing The Building System!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Settlers! [/b]

As we continue to develop Pathless Woods, we would like to connect and give you a behind-the-scenes look at the development of Pathless Woods through our dev updates!

In this dev update, we'd like to share with you about what we've been working on recently - optimizing the building construction system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/51029c6ced873d6edeb297d6985aaec8b2af691a.png[/img]

If you were previously involved in our closed beta, you would have noticed that there were some issues in the original building construction system such as not having a proper auto-align mode and frequent misalignment issues where players could only use the lines on the ground as a reference for building. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/bc4b0242a09541fec40e6ce60c826abe55f1d6ab.gif[/img]

With Pathless Woods being a game that allows for extensive building and crafting, it was crucial for us to ensure that each building part type had its own specific alignment rules and designs. As such, we have improved the auto-align mode of the building construction system to ensure a smooth experience for players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/4306442838063dac14c90b824e03478bef53c041.png[/img]

With these improvements, building on uneven terrain and adding tiles to roofs will be easier and more precise, allowing players to express their creativity and build their own world without limits. No more worrying about "shaky hands" ruining your creations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/037910bb1f5dae2a477bbbb4e33fe858dd72bfdb.png[/img]

As we continue on our journey to make the Pathless Woods gaming experience better for everyone, the next steps ahead for us would be focusing on updating the in-game interaction interface and adding new and exciting features. Although we can't reveal all the details just yet, we are confident that the improvements we are making to the interface and character movements will result in a more convenient and immersive experience for players.

And with that, we wrap up this installment of our development progress for Pathless Woods! We would love to hear from you and know what else you're curious about in our game. Feel free to reach out to us through various channels, and we'll be happy to answer any questions you may have!

notes.title: Welcome to the Pathless Woods!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Settlers! [/b]

How are you?

Welcome! We are just getting ready to unveil more details about our game and post with more frequency as we are planning to have a playtest in the future. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/5483217c40040fccf003ccbecf9b73aadef9e700.gif[/img]

First of all, Pathless Woods is a sandbox-style survival game that takes players on an adventure through a sealed land. We have designed it to be an immersive world which offers diverse gameplay mechanics. You will journey through a mysterious land shrouded in an unknown fog, filled with lush forests, open fields, toxic swamps and abandoned ruins. The game offers a variety of activities such as exploration, construction, and farming, where you can gather resources, craft items, build your own homeland, plant and tend your crops to a bountiful harvest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/c49c983f55d8e5cb6eb42be30332b2200886280b.gif[/img]

As you explore the Pathless Woods, you'll have the opportunity to gather resources and craft a variety of items to help you on your journey. Gather resources by logging, mining, and gathering in the wild. With these resources, you can craft a variety of tools and items that are essential for survival in the wild, such as axes and hammers, and hunting weapons. The possibilities are endless!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/7dafdfd1a398256eab5eec78374fff4a93d223af.png[/img]

In addition to exploring and gathering resources, you would be able to engage in farming activities such as building your own paddy fields, planting and tending your crops until they grow into a bountiful harvest. Be sure to manage your resources carefully in order to optimize your harvest and yield the best results possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/48bded421bcef7981dfb813286c4f98760779bfa.jpg[/img]

As you progress through the game, you'll also have the chance to build your own homeland in the Pathless Woods. With a variety of building materials and structures to choose from, you can create the home of your dreams, whether it be a simple hut or a grand mansion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/dd5fe4fb568b0bdec696ebb154f52e468012e102.png[/img]

However, the game offers a real sense of danger too, with enemies called the Jaer Cultists, who pose a threat to all players. They are well-equipped and dangerous, so building and fortifying your home is important as it will provide you with a safe-haven from the cultists. 

We hope this article has helped you understand more about Pathless Woods, and over the course of the next few months, we will be sharing more announcements and updates on this exciting new sandbox survival game. We can't wait for you to join us on this journey and to experience the full depth and breadth of Pathless Woods for yourself!
